_source: The real MapLevelProgress sheet's header row (CookOrder GDD New - MapLevelProgress.csv): Map,Level,ID,Ingredient Weights,Customer Dishes Sequence,Complexity Curve,Shuffle Curve,Design Note,Weather,Tag,Num Customers,Num Dishes,Num Ingredients,New Object Ids,Tut Id,Customers,Grid,Queues,... — columns A-R.
_note: Column indexes are 0-based (0=A, 1=B, ...). These are just the starting defaults — the Remote Data tab also lets a designer override each of the 7 field columns from its own UI (letters, e.g. 'D'), in case the real sheet's layout ever shifts; this file only supplies the initial values shown there.
